stem.text: Which statement comparing magnesium and barium, or their compounds, is correct?

A.text: Magnesium reacts with dilute hydrochloric acid more rapidly than barium does.

B.text: One mole of magnesium carbonate gives off a greater amount of gas when it reacts with an excess of dilute hydrochloric acid than one mole of barium carbonate does.

C.text: The solubility of magnesium sulfate in water is greater than the solubility of barium sulfate in water.

D.text: Magnesium carbonate undergoes thermal decomposition **less** readily than barium carbonate does.
